title: trinia vulgaris subsp. carniolica
intro: Trinia vulgaris subsp. carniolica, commonly known as Alpine Trinia, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, due to its ability to aid in digestion and alleviate various gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Alpine Trinia include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve gut health, and provide antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which work together to exert its medicinal properties.
